notes: Seed 2026-11-17-5b6c, census mode (mode draw). Subjects: research/ambient-crossfit, ventures/terraform-plan-secret-exposure-check, ventures/atm-route-margin, ventures/jwt-verification-misuse-check, research/osrobot-leannoise, research/sensing-burst. 0 of 6 meet the bar, 6 of 6 finished; seeded mutants caught 10 of 34. Sampled share unchanged 33/306 (8%-15%). Fix PR: #17037 (all fixes in this PR): atm hourly rate double-counted labour (+test); terraform outputs with after_sensitive flagged as leaks and an explainer page claiming show -json hides values (+test); JWT Go rule disabled by net/http r.Method (+tests in both engines) and llms.txt boilerplate; osrobot-leannoise delay claim was a start-pose clamp artefact (README corrected, test pinning 138/200); ambient-crossfit diverging Newton fit_map (README warning, homepage caveat, Known gaps; ~10 sibling ambient-* projects share it); sensing-burst zero-clamp asymmetry (Known gaps). Spot-checks I reran: atm defaults hourly 46.33 vs 71.33; terraform CLI exit 1 -> 0; leannoise probe (1.00 safe at all delays from y=0); sensing-burst clamp at P=30 (18.70/15.98/16.83); ambient-crossfit weights [-369,-69,-173,-554]. Local checks: atm 83/83, terraform 51/51, jwt node 32/32 + pytest 32/32, leannoise 5/5 unittest; quality_audit validate 0 problems; post front-matter/links/similarity clean; research homepage builds (1080 projects).

human_equivalent.basis: six first audits at about 2 h each by a senior reviewer plus four small fixes with tests

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
